title: Picsart expands Claude tools #picsart #claudecode #aivideo
description:
Picsart connected more than 130 creative models directly to Claude Code, turning a coding assistant into a unified workspace for image editing, video generation, audio tasks, background removal, and upscaling.

The integration combines models like Flux, Kling, and Veo with built-in creative skills, so users can run ready-made workflows inside a single conversation instead of jumping between separate apps. A simple prompt can remove a background, place a subject into a new scene, upscale the result to 4K, and animate it into video.

The broader shift is toward conversational creative production, where AI tools collapse multiple stages of content creation into one interface. For creators, that means faster iteration, fewer tool switches, and a much more efficient path from one photo to a polished, animated asset.
